title: Professor Layton and the Last Specter
subtitle: Before Luke became an apprentice
summary: Professor Layton and the Last Specter is Level-5's Nintendo DS prequel showing how Layton first met Luke. Joined by assistant Emmy Altava, he investigates the village of Misthallery and the mystery surrounding its apparent specter. body: Professor Layton and the Last Specter is Level-5's Nintendo DS prequel showing how Layton first met Luke. Joined by assistant Emmy Altava, he investigates the village of Misthallery and the mystery surrounding its apparent specter. Released as The Spectre's Call in Europe, it moves the series back before the original trilogy. That change lets the familiar partnership begin again as a question rather than an established fact. The player explores illustrated streets, talks to residents and solves the puzzles that stand between a rumour and its explanation.

Touching the scenery can reveal dialogue, hint coins, collectibles or hidden puzzles, while a visible resident can be selected for a conversation. The village opens gradually as the investigation progresses. Puzzles that become inaccessible can be recovered later by Keats the Cat, preserving an opportunity to solve them. The system encourages attention without requiring every discovery to happen at the first possible moment. Misthallery becomes a place that can be searched patiently, with the same image offering another reason to look after its first conversation has ended.

Some editions also include Professor Layton's London Life, a separate role-playing diversion set in Little London with characters from the series. It was omitted from the European release, an important difference beneath the regional title change. The main investigation keeps the series' varied brainteasers and measured pace, while the prequel gives Luke's behaviour another significance. The audience already knows who he will become. Watching the relationship form allows an ordinary exchange or successful deduction to carry part of that future companionship before the characters themselves recognise it.
story_headings: Search the village with a tap
A larger life around the mystery
